original_clauses.source_paraphrase: During the Xbox network outage, users reported that some games installed from physical discs would not launch because the offline entitlement route did not preserve access for those users, even though Microsoft later said disc-based play should continue by design using saved entitlements. The particular console or entitlement state that failed is not established, and a planned update is not evidence of completed recovery for every affected console.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: When remote verification is unavailable, a locally valid physical-disc entitlement should remain usable through a tested offline or saved-entitlement route; service failure should not silently invalidate otherwise valid local access.
